title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

An AI industry downturn sets in by May 18, 2027

Polymarket asks this downturn by December 31, 2026 and by June 30, 2027 on identical rules (three of six triggers inside 90 days). May 18 falls between; I read the date at a constant daily hazard between the two deadlines, since no scheduled date concentrates the risk.
